purpose: Track only gaps that still matter before the sourcing database is review-ready. A missing perfect China quote or perfect white-background photo is not automatically a blocker when reliable secondary evidence exists.

price_status_summary.reference_ready_or_provisional: Most ordinary core materials now have either an established China price band, a same-spec China anchor ladder, or strong secondary wholesale anchors with bead count/spec exposed.
price_status_summary.specialist_model_ready: Akoya, Tahitian, South Sea, agarwood, amber/beeswax, jadeite, Hetian/nephrite, turquoise, Larimar and Sugilite have identity-first sourcing rules; specialist evidence continues to improve without forcing an 8mm universal band.
remaining_nonblocking_calibration: 黑发晶：ordinary 8mm China anchors exist; a clean premium/high loose-bead anchor would improve the high tier.
兔毛水晶：green/red branches have market evidence; clean same-spec premium ladders would improve final branch bands.
胶花水晶：ordinary round and freeform anchors exist; premium round-bead ladder remains desirable.
部分国际批发锚点材料（彼得石、苔藓玛瑙、堇青石、蓝晶石、黑碧玺、阿拉善、樱花玛瑙等）：China domestic calibration would improve confidence but is no longer required before review-ready export.
盐源玛瑙：raw 7-8/8-8.5mm wholesale reference range now exists; China domestic raw-bead calibration remains optional.
identity_or_branch_rules_not_missing_pri: 黄水晶：keep treatment disclosure; most commercial citrine is heat-treated, so untreated status must never be assumed.
摩根石：clean natural/undyed wholesale anchors now exist; painted/烤漆 market goods remain quarantined.
小叶紫檀：seller-claimed price ladders exist; species identity gate is mandatory and Zambia bloodwood is a separate wood class.
南红、黑曜石、蜜蜡/琥珀、绿松石、珍珠：commercial/treatment/identity branches remain separate by design rather than being averaged.

photo_status_summary.reference_ready: Key round-bead, freeform and accessory recognition images are broadly covered across v1-v5 evidence files.
nonblocking_improvements: 景观玛瑙：explicit landscape-agate single bead and wholesale strand references exist; a raw drilled single bead without silver sleeve would still be a nicer final sourcing image.
红兔毛：loose-bead and 8mm finished references exist; a single white-background loose 8mm bead is optional improvement.
阿拉善/盐源：usable sourcing/source-page references exist; stable single-bead direct image URLs can still be improved.
photo_status_summary.intentional_block: 金色金属件 remains intentionally blank until its base-material system is chosen.

remaining_real_blockers.why: The mother library has 93 historical/design working specs, but this does not yet provide a simple procurement-ready 2-4-spec set for every active material.
remaining_real_blockers.decision_needed: Choose whether to standardize a small number of sourcing-spec profiles rather than expanding every material into many diameters/forms.
remaining_real_blockers.recommended: Use simple profile-based minimum sourcing specs, normally 2-4 useful specs per material, with 8mm as the comparison baseline where appropriate and freeform/focal specs only where the material benefits from them.

remaining_real_blockers.why: Gold-tone hardware cannot have a trustworthy price/photo/spec line until the base system is chosen (e.g. silver plated/vermeil, gold-filled, brass plated).
remaining_real_blockers.decision_needed: Later, only when gold-tone sourcing becomes active.
remaining_real_blockers.recommended: Do not block the rest of the database now.

remaining_real_blockers.why: Supplier batch treatment/origin/species and samples cannot exist before a real sourcing batch/supplier is selected.
remaining_real_blockers.decision_needed: No; this belongs to future procurement approval, not mother-library completion.
